programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: To open series three Food Safari explores the colorful cuisine of South America with passionate chefs and home-cooks. Maeve O'Meara joins chef Jorge Chacon to learn about the particular flavors and ingredients that make South American food really special. Chef Juan Gomez makes Colombian style arepas and Chilean musician Gema Badiola prepares a fragrant, all-purpose salsa called pebre.

programs.title: The Chocolate Queen
programs.desc: A feast for dessert lovers awaits in this episode! Kirsten brings Italian-inspired magic to the kitchen with her chocolate custard tarts, simple yet stunning pistachio bark.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Adam Swanson joins the kitchen today to make his spicy couscous falafels with tahini yoghurt and Justine makes two scrumptious desserts - a pear and blueberry pie and a creamy passionfruit syllabub.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Tonight, Adam has put 20 minutes on the clock and asked chef Lillian Kaskoutas and comedian Nick White to make some speedy but sensational dinners.

programs.title: Locals Welcome
programs.desc: Suresh Doss takes viewers on a journey to explore the country's best neighbourhood restaurants.

programs.title: Richo's Hungry Az Hell
programs.desc: We're closing the season with the recipes Richo has flexed for decades. The dishes people beg him for, fight over, and try to recreate at home. Classic Richo flavours, and absolutely no apologies.
